chart.summary: Engram is a local CLI that stores a compact repository Cortex written and maintained by AI agents; it deliberately performs no source scanning, parsing, ranking, or fact inference.

areas.label: Cortex storage
areas.summary: The CLI creates, reads, replaces, validates, and atomically patches .engram/cortex.json.

areas.label: Cerebellum
areas.summary: init installs the Cerebellum, which tells agents how to form and maintain the Cortex.

workflows.label: Bootstrap
workflows.summary: A user copies the README prompt into an agent; the agent runs init, reads the Cerebellum, forms the first Cortex, and validates it.

workflows.label: Maintenance
workflows.summary: Agents update or remove Cortex entries after meaningful code changes or when they notice a disagreement with the repository.

decisions.label: Agent-owned knowledge
decisions.summary: All repository understanding is authored and maintained by agents, not derived by Engram from code.

conventions.label: Minimal docs
conventions.summary: README and docs stay concise; the Cerebellum contains the operative workflow.
